content: I need to upgrade the <your-org> site to Astro 5
I can help you migrate to Astro 5. The main changes involve content collections and the new config format.
I prefer using custom CSS over Tailwind for everything
Noted. I'll use plain CSS with custom properties throughout.
Let's use nomic-embed-text for all embeddings on the Mini
Good choice — nomic-embed-text is fast on M1 and free.
